Jatin Mehta
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Gurgaon
jatin.mehta299@example.com | +91 9443276174

Seasoned digital marketing manager with a track record of driving measurable growth through paid search, organic SEO, and social campaigns. Experienced in translating business objectives into data-driven acquisition strategies, optimizing funnels, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver scalable results.

Experience

Wipro — Apr 2017 - Present
Senior Digital Marketing Manager
- Led Google Ads campaigns for a portfolio of B2B SaaS and enterprise clients, reducing cost-per-lead by 32% year-over-year while increasing qualified lead volume by 48% through bid strategies, ad copy testing, and landing page optimizations.
- Developed and executed Social Media Marketing plans across LinkedIn and Twitter, growing targeted audience engagement by 85% and generating a 22% increase in marketing-sourced pipeline over 12 months.
- Collaborated with analytics and product teams on A/B tests and conversion rate improvements, implementing tracking that improved lead attribution accuracy by 40% and informed budget reallocation.
- Managed a cross-functional team and vendor relationships, delivering a 3x improvement in campaign setup velocity and maintaining a 95% on-time campaign launch rate.

Kite Learning — Jun 2013 - Mar 2017
SEO Specialist
- Implemented SEO strategy and technical fixes that increased organic search traffic by 120% in 18 months and improved visibility for 50+ target keywords into top-3 positions.
- Ran integrated campaigns combining HubSpot workflows, Social Media Marketing and paid search; optimized Google Ads campaigns to lower CPA by 28% while boosting enrollments by 35%.
- Set up Google Analytics tracking and dashboards to monitor user journeys, reducing bounce rate on key landing pages by 24% through content and UX improvements.
- Trained content and marketing teams on SEO best practices and HubSpot usage, shortening content production cycle by 20% and improving lead nurturing conversion rates.

Projects
- Lead Gen Dashboard: Built an internal reporting dashboard integrating Google Analytics and Google Ads metrics to visualize funnel conversion and campaign ROI; reduced weekly reporting time from 6 hours to 30 minutes.
- Social Growth Sprint: Ran a 12-week Social Media Marketing pilot for a new product line, achieving a 4.5% click-to-lead rate and a 15% lift in trial sign-ups.

Skills
- SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics
- Social Media Marketing, HubSpot
- Linux, Jira

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
